name: Firrerre
description: Firrerre was a world in the Outer Rim Territories' Sugai sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector. It was the site of a consular office for New Republic Space Ministry that issued the METOSP titled 558 ModSuFi, warning spacers to avoid the planet Jakku.
